name: Ban or Get Banned 🔨
desc:
🚨 Welcome to Ban or Get Banned! 🚨
The most fun, chaotic, and troll Roblox game where your mission is simple:
👉 Ban… or be banned! 👈

👮‍♂️ Game Features:

🔨 Use Robux or in-game currency to temporarily ban other players.

⏰ Choose from multiple ban durations: 5 minutes, 1 hour, and more.

📋 Access the Ban Panel with all kinds of powers and options.

🔁 Revenge system: if you get banned… get ready to strike back!

🎁 Claim daily rewards, unlock secret zones, and increase your influence.

💣 Discover and use forbidden and special items to dominate the server.

⚠️ Note: All bans are part of the game and not real. Players are never actually banned from Roblox.

🔥 Are you ready to become the most feared (or loved) player on the server?
Play now and start banning!
